coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rentals: single-family homes, mobile homes and mobile home park sites, apartment buildings and complexes, and rooming and boarding houses. Owner-occupied two- and three-family dwellings fall outside the full good-cause list and are subject only to a narrower list of causes.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied (landlord-occupied) two- and three-family dwellings are excluded from the full good-cause list and follow a narrower list of eviction causes.
coverage.other_conditions: Hotel and motel guests are covered if they have no alternate residence and live at the hotel or motel on a continual basis.

result.notes: I removed the landlord-registration condition from other_conditions because it describes landlord conduct (failing to register), not covered buildings or units. I also removed the list of eviction causes and notice periods from owner_conditions for the same reason; that field now states only the owner-occupancy scope. I set requires_unknown_facts to true because coverage depends on facts usually not on record: owner occupancy, transient or seasonal status, and trust arrangements for a disabled family member. owner_occupied_exemption_max_units=3 is kept. It is based on the guide's statement about two- or three-unit owner-occupied premises, but the guide's wording ('with two (2) or fewer rental units') is ambiguous.
